t.zh: <wiki-ref to="circuit"></wiki-ref>只接一次，由机器在每一行上运行。<part-ref to="part:gNot"></part-ref>表示否定 ¬。
t.en: A <wiki-ref to="circuit"></wiki-ref> is wired once, and the machine runs it on every row. <part-ref to="part:gNot"></part-ref> stands for negation, ¬.

brief.zh: 接一块电路，算出「不是『不下雨』」在每一行的真值。
brief.en: Wire a board that works out the value of “it is not the case that it is not raining” on every row.

hint.zh: 「不下雨」怎样接？再否定一次呢？
hint.en: How is “it is not raining” wired? And negated once more?
